curatorReview.scope: All truth.style exact/family/related labels across the final 36 works (71 distinct labels) audited against the 591-label taxonomy; the grader (gradeStyle) now canonicalizes both accepted truth labels and free-text guesses through this map before assigning exact/family/related credit.
curatorReview.note: Genuine same-concept merges only (Ptolemaic, Rapa Nui, Joseon, two non-pilot Egyptian pairs, plus the Greco/Graeco spelling). Qin dynasty vs Qing dynasty confirmed distinct; specific children (e.g. Joseon dynasty literati painting) are NOT collapsed; parent/child relations are handled by the family/related hierarchy, not the dedup map.

note: Exact site labels and relations are frozen here. Curator must resolve audit-labels near-duplicates before the protocol freeze; raw labels are never discarded.

curatorDedupNotes.Ptolemaic Egyptian art: Same culture/period as 'Ptolemaic Egypt' (identical dates c. 305-30 BCE); '...art' suffix variant. Pilot truth uses 'Ptolemaic Egypt' (work cleveland159061), so canonical = 'Ptolemaic Egypt'.
curatorDedupNotes.Rapa Nui: Same culture as 'Rapa Nui people' (same region/overlapping dates c.1200). Pilot truth uses 'Rapa Nui people' (work Q28792214), so canonical = 'Rapa Nui people'.
curatorDedupNotes.Joseon dynasty: Same top-of-tradition period as 'Joseon Korean' (Korea, 1392-1897/1910); dynasty-noun vs culture-adjective phrasing. Pilot truth uses 'Joseon Korean' (work Q12588609). NOTE: children 'Joseon dynasty chaekgeori' and 'Joseon dynasty literati painting' are more-specific and remain distinct - do NOT collapse those.
curatorDedupNotes.Late Period Egyptian: Non-pilot. Same concept as 'Late Period Egypt' (identical dates c. 664-332 BCE); '...Egyptian' adjective vs '...Egypt' period form. Canonical follows the Ptolemaic precedent (period form).
curatorDedupNotes.Predynastic Egyptian: Non-pilot. Same concept as 'Predynastic Egypt' (Predynastic Upper Egypt); adjective vs period form. Canonical = period form.
curatorDedupNotes.Greco-Roman: US-spelling variant of the truth label "Graeco-Roman"; canonicalized so either spelling scores identically.
